# Scope

Compare the nine corrected batch-effect cohorts using the same MDS panels,
metrics, and funkyheatmap layout as `batch_effect_analysis_uncorrected.rmd`.
Biological labels are used for evaluation only. No preprocessing, correction,
embeddings, or distances are recomputed.

When mounted, read the NAS `batch_effect/corrected_final/results` bundles and
the sibling `embeddings` and sample `metadata` directories. Reuse persisted R
scores; score the Python methods' persisted sample distances. Process one cohort
at a time, writing MDS panels and retaining only heatmap scores. The first
NAS-backed run saves a small score/provenance snapshot locally; later runs
without the NAS read that snapshot for the heatmap only. MDS generation requires
the mounted NAS; an offline score snapshot cannot reconstruct sample coordinates
or batch labels. No H5AD, pseudobulk, or full result bundle is copied locally.
A mounted but incomplete/corrupt NAS source fails closed rather than silently
using an older local snapshot.

Paired Alzheimer figures require the same 104 donor-by-assay sample IDs, in the
same order, on both sides. The historical uncorrected manifest still selects
83 donor-only samples and is rejected; current figures cannot be regenerated
until the missing uncorrected composition/null/summary artifacts are recovered
and new source-bound manifests are supplied. Existing 83-versus-104 PDFs are
stale, not evidence of a correction-induced change in sample count.

Dataset column labels include the number of cell types actually used by
`ECODA_authors_HR`, counted from its corrected sample-by-cell-type feature matrix
and preserved in the offline snapshot.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (basename(getwd()) == "notebooks") {
  setwd("..")
  if (file.exists(".Rprofile")) source(".Rprofile")
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(funkyheatmap)
})
source("src/utils/constants.R")
source("src/utils/datasets_io.R")
source("src/utils/math_utils.R")
source("src/utils/scoring_metrics.R")
source("src/utils/batch_effect_analysis.R")
source("src/utils/plotting.R")

set.seed(42)
# ANOSIM's statistic does not depend on permutation draws; retain the reference
# notebook's permutation setting and bound its forked workers on macOS.
n_permutations <- 999L
detected_cores <- parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE)
if (is.na(detected_cores)) detected_cores <- 1L
parallel_cores <- min(8L, max(1L, detected_cores))

nas_root <- "/Volumes/Shared/Projects/ECODA_paper/batch_effect/corrected_final"
nas_results_root <- file.path(nas_root, "results")
analysis_root <- file.path(getwd(), "data", "batch_effect", "corrected")
# Snapshots are immutable derived outputs. Change this ID deliberately when
# accepting a new upstream result revision; never overwrite an old snapshot.
snapshot_id <- "20261105_corrected_heatmap"
snapshot_path <- file.path(analysis_root, snapshot_id, "heatmap_scores.csv")
plot_root <- file.path(getwd(), "plots", "batch_effect_corrected")
plot_path <- file.path(plot_root, "batch_effect_corrected_funkyheatmap.pdf")

batch_datasets <- c(
  "Alzheimer", "Breast_cancer", "Covid19_PBMC", "Kidney_KPMP_full",
  "Diabetes", "Lupus_PBMC", "Lung", "Joanito", "Stephenson"
)
datasets <- read_datasets_json(view = "batch_effect_corrected")
stopifnot(all(batch_datasets %in% names(datasets)))
method_specs <- batch_uncorrected_method_specs()
method_specs <- lapply(method_specs, function(spec) {
  spec$relative_path <- sub("batch_effect_uncorrected", "batch_effect_corrected_final", spec$relative_path, fixed = TRUE)
  spec
})
method_specs$ECODA_authors_HR_NULL <- list(
  method = "ECODA_authors_HR_NULL", kind = "rds",
  relative_path = "results/{dataset}_batch_effect_corrected_final_composition.rds",
  bundle_key = "ECODA_authors_HR_NULL"
)
selected_methods <- names(method_specs)
mds_methods <- setdiff(selected_methods, "ECODA_authors_HR_NULL")
metric_keys <- c(ANOSIM = "anosim_score", Modularity = "mod_knn3_score", ARI = "cluster_score")
stopifnot(!anyNA(method_label_map_main[selected_methods]))
```

# Biological groups versus batch: sample contingency tables

This chunk writes the same shared current-cohort report as the uncorrected
notebook, using current corrected-final sample metadata rather than expression
or distance matrices. Alzheimer has 104 donor-by-assay samples.

Find heatmaps in `plots/batch_effect_bio_vs_batch/` and count/composition CSVs in
`data/batch_effect/bio_vs_batch/tables/`. Each batch field and their combination
gets a matrix with batch rows and biological-group columns. Heatmap cells show
sample counts and within-batch percentages; composition CSVs additionally show
within-biological-group percentages. Zeros and missing `<NA>` levels are retained.
A pure batch provides no within-batch contrast; inspect whether the biological
groups share batches before interpreting correction as separable from biology.
Run this chunk after `setup` without loading method results or plotting MDS.

The shared report also writes a Kidney-only `region.l1` versus `condition.l1`
matrix using the same sample metadata and count/percentage conventions.
Anatomical region is diagnostic only, not a configured correction field.
Unrecorded regions are retained in the `<NA>` row.

```{r bio-batch-tables, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
bio_batch_provenance <- write_batch_biology_report(
  nas_root = nas_root,
  source_root = "/srv/beegfs/scratch/users/h/halterc/ECODA_paper/batch_effect/corrected_final",
  datasets = datasets,
  dataset_order = batch_datasets,
  plot_root = file.path(getwd(), "plots", "batch_effect_bio_vs_batch"),
  table_root = file.path(getwd(), "data", "batch_effect", "bio_vs_batch", "tables")
)
bio_batch_provenance[, c("dataset", "n_samples", "biological_column", "batch_columns")]
```

# Load validated corrected scores

NAS sidecars retain the original Yggdrasil scratch `PATH`. Validate that exact
source-to-NAS mapping, MD5, and size before reading each artifact; do not rewrite
production sidecars. The local snapshot has its own local `MD5/SIZE/PATH` sidecar
and records every input checksum, source path, cohort, method, and sample count.

```{r load-scores, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
read_corrected_scores <- function() {
  # Explicit ownership mapping for this corrected-final publication lane.
  source_root <- "/srv/beegfs/scratch/users/h/halterc/ECODA_paper/batch_effect/corrected_final"
  validate_nas <- function(relative_path) {
    path <- file.path(nas_root, relative_path)
    if (!file.exists(path) || isTRUE(file.info(path)$isdir) || file.info(path)$size <= 0) {
      stop("Missing or empty corrected artifact: ", path)
    }
    fields <- .batch_sidecar_fields(path)
    if (!identical(fields$PATH, file.path(source_root, relative_path)) ||
        !identical(tolower(fields$MD5), tolower(unname(tools::md5sum(path)))) ||
        !identical(fields$SIZE, as.character(file.info(path)$size))) {
      stop("Corrected artifact ownership/checksum/size mismatch: ", path)
    }
    list(path = path, md5 = fields$MD5)
  }

  uncorrected_root <- file.path(getwd(), "data", "batch_effect", "uncorrected_final")
  uncorrected_metadata <- read_batch_final_manifest(
    file.path(uncorrected_root, "final_analysis_metadata.tsv"),
    expected_datasets = batch_datasets, expected_methods = selected_methods
  )
  uncorrected_artifacts <- read_batch_final_manifest(
    file.path(uncorrected_root, "final_analysis_artifacts.tsv"),
    expected_datasets = batch_datasets, expected_methods = selected_methods
  )
  uncorrected_registry <- batch_candidate_registry(datasets, batch_datasets)

  dataset_tables <- lapply(batch_datasets, function(dataset) {
    message("Reading corrected scores: ", dataset)
    metadata <- validate_nas(file.path("results", paste0(dataset, "_batch_effect_corrected_final_metadata.rds")))
    summary <- readRDS(metadata$path)
    labels <- summary$labels
    sample_ids <- names(labels)
    if (is.null(sample_ids) || length(labels) < 4L || anyNA(labels) ||
        anyNA(sample_ids) || any(!nzchar(sample_ids)) || anyDuplicated(sample_ids) ||
        length(unique(labels)) < 2L || length(unique(labels)) >= length(labels)) {
      stop(dataset, ": invalid named biological evaluation labels")
    }
    if (dataset == "Alzheimer" && length(sample_ids) != 104L) {
      stop("Alzheimer figures require exactly 104 donor-by-assay samples")
    }
    # Read each R bundle only once; discard all matrices before the next cohort.
    bundles <- list()
    mds_results <- list()
    method_tables <- lapply(selected_methods, function(method) {
      spec <- method_specs[[method]]
      relative <- gsub("{dataset}", dataset, spec$relative_path, fixed = TRUE)
      artifact <- validate_nas(relative)
      if (spec$kind == "rds") {
        if (is.null(bundles[[relative]])) bundles[[relative]] <<- readRDS(artifact$path)
        result <- bundles[[relative]][[spec$bundle_key]]
        if (is.null(result$scores) || !all(unname(metric_keys) %in% names(result$scores))) {
          stop(dataset, "/", method, ": missing persisted heatmap scores")
        }
        matrix <- .batch_validate_matrix(as.matrix(result$dist_mat), sample_ids, paste(dataset, method))
        distance <- stats::as.dist(matrix)
        # The null control intentionally uses shuffled rather than primary labels.
        if (method != "ECODA_authors_HR_NULL" &&
            (!identical(names(result$labels), sample_ids) ||
             !identical(as.character(result$labels), as.character(labels)))) {
          stop(dataset, "/", method, ": result labels disagree with metadata")
        }
        values <- vapply(unname(metric_keys), function(key) {
          value <- result$scores[[key]]
          if (!is.numeric(value) || length(value) != 1L) stop("Invalid score: ", method, "/", key)
          as.numeric(value)
        }, numeric(1))
        score_source <- "persisted_scores"
      } else {
        frame <- as.data.frame(arrow::read_feather(artifact$path))
        index <- as.character(frame[[ncol(frame)]])
        matrix <- as.matrix(frame[, -ncol(frame), drop = FALSE])
        rownames(matrix) <- index
        matrix <- .batch_validate_matrix(matrix, sample_ids, paste(dataset, method))
        if (!isTRUE(all.equal(matrix, t(matrix), tolerance = 1e-8)) || any(abs(diag(matrix)) > 1e-8)) {
          stop(dataset, "/", method, ": invalid symmetric distance matrix")
        }
        distance <- stats::as.dist(matrix)
        anosim <- compute_batch_anosim(distance, labels, permutations = n_permutations, parallel = parallel_cores)
        if (anosim$status != "ESTIMABLE") stop(dataset, "/", method, ": ", anosim$warning)
        values <- c(anosim$statistic, calc_modularity(distance, labels, 3), clust_eval(distance, labels))
        score_source <- "persisted_distance"
      }
      if (any(!is.finite(values))) stop(dataset, "/", method, ": non-finite heatmap scores")
      if (method %in% mds_methods) {
        mds_results[[method]] <<- list(
          dist_mat = distance,
          scores = if (spec$kind == "rds") result$scores else NULL
        )
      }
      data.frame(
        dataset = dataset, method_key = method, score = names(metric_keys), value = values,
        source = score_source, n_samples = length(sample_ids),
        artifact_path = artifact$path, artifact_md5 = artifact$md5,
        metadata_path = metadata$path, metadata_md5 = metadata$md5,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    })
    author_features <- bundles[[paste0("results/", dataset, "_batch_effect_corrected_final_composition.rds")]][["ECODA_authors_HR"]]$feat_mat
    if (length(dim(author_features)) != 2L || ncol(author_features) < 1L ||
        !identical(rownames(author_features), sample_ids)) {
      stop(dataset, ": missing or misaligned ECODA_authors cell-type features")
    }
    table <- do.call(rbind, method_tables)
    table$n_cell_types <- ncol(author_features)

    metadata_artifact <- validate_nas(file.path("metadata", paste0(dataset, "_sample_metadata.feather")))
    sample_metadata <- as.data.frame(arrow::read_feather(metadata_artifact$path))
    label_col <- datasets[[dataset]]$label_col
    if (!all(c("Sample", label_col) %in% names(sample_metadata)) ||
        !identical(as.character(sample_metadata$Sample), sample_ids) ||
        !identical(.batch_values(sample_metadata[[label_col]]), .batch_values(labels))) {
      stop(dataset, ": corrected sample metadata does not match the result sample order/labels")
    }
    uncorrected_result <- load_batch_uncorrected_dataset_from_manifest(
      uncorrected_metadata, uncorrected_artifacts, dataset, uncorrected_registry
    )
    panels <- plot_batch_mds_comparison(
      uncorrected_result,
      list(dataset = dataset, metadata = sample_metadata, label_col = label_col, methods = mds_results),
      datasets[[dataset]]$batch_col,
      method_label_map_main[mds_methods]
    )
    if (dataset == "Kidney_KPMP_full") {
      region_col <- "region.l1"
      if (!region_col %in% names(sample_metadata) ||
          !region_col %in% names(uncorrected_result$metadata) ||
          !identical(.batch_values(sample_metadata[[region_col]]),
                     .batch_values(uncorrected_result$metadata[[region_col]]))) {
        stop(dataset, ": missing or inconsistent anatomical region between MDS lanes")
      }
      region_panels <- plot_batch_mds_comparison(
        uncorrected_result,
        list(dataset = dataset, metadata = sample_metadata, label_col = label_col, methods = mds_results),
        region_col, method_label_map_main[mds_methods]
      )
      region_panel <- region_panels[[paste0("batch_", region_col)]]
      region_panel <- region_panel +
        patchwork::plot_annotation(subtitle = paste0("Region: ", region_col))
      panels$region <- region_panel & ggplot2::labs(color = "Region")
    }
    dir.create(plot_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    for (name in names(panels)) {
      suffix <- if (name == "biological") "" else paste0("_", name)
      path <- file.path(plot_root, paste0(dataset, "_mds", suffix, ".pdf"))
      ggplot2::ggsave(path, plot = panels[[name]], width = 13, height = 24, units = "in", device = "pdf")
      stopifnot(file.exists(path), file.info(path)$size > 0)
    }
    table
  })
  do.call(rbind, dataset_tables)
}

if (dir.exists(nas_root)) {
  if (!dir.exists(nas_results_root)) stop("Mounted NAS lacks corrected results: ", nas_results_root)
  funky_metric_data <- read_corrected_scores()
  if (file.exists(snapshot_path)) {
    validate_batch_artifact(snapshot_path, "local corrected score snapshot")
    previous <- read.csv(snapshot_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    if (!isTRUE(all.equal(previous, funky_metric_data, check.attributes = FALSE))) {
      stop("Corrected scores/provenance changed; choose a new snapshot_id before saving a new snapshot")
    }
  } else {
    write_batch_analysis_table(funky_metric_data, snapshot_path)
  }
  message("Source: corrected-final NAS results; local snapshot: ", snapshot_path)
} else {
  if (!file.exists(snapshot_path)) {
    stop("NAS is not mounted and no local score snapshot exists. Mount the NAS and run this notebook once: ", snapshot_path)
  }
  validate_batch_artifact(snapshot_path, "local corrected score snapshot")
  funky_metric_data <- read.csv(snapshot_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  message("Source: local corrected score snapshot: ", snapshot_path)
  message("MDS panels are not regenerated offline: mount the corrected-final NAS to create them.")
}

expected <- expand.grid(dataset = batch_datasets, method_key = selected_methods, score = names(metric_keys), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
key <- function(data) paste(data$dataset, data$method_key, data$score, sep = "/")
if (anyDuplicated(key(funky_metric_data)) || !setequal(key(funky_metric_data), key(expected)) ||
    any(!is.finite(funky_metric_data$value)) || anyNA(funky_metric_data$n_samples) ||
    any(funky_metric_data$n_samples < 4L) || anyNA(funky_metric_data$n_cell_types) ||
    any(funky_metric_data$n_cell_types < 1L)) {
  stop("Corrected heatmap snapshot must contain exactly nine cohorts × eight methods × three finite metrics")
}
funky_metric_data$method <- unname(method_label_map_main[funky_metric_data$method_key])
dataset_summary <- funky_metric_data %>% distinct(dataset, n_samples, n_cell_types)
stopifnot(nrow(dataset_summary) == length(batch_datasets))
dataset_summary
```

# Biological- and batch-coloured MDS

The NAS-backed `load-scores` chunk writes paired MDS panels for the seven
non-shuffled methods: **uncorrected on the left, corrected on the right**, one
method per row. Uncorrected inputs come from the same validated mixed-source
manifests as `batch_effect_analysis_uncorrected.rmd`; corrected inputs are the
validated NAS distances and metadata loaded above.

Biological labels, each dataset-level `columns.batch` field from `datasets.json`,
and the observed combination of all batch fields receive separate panels.
Label colours are shared between both sides, including groups present on only
one side. All colourings reuse the same coordinates within each method/lane.
Both sides must have identical sample IDs and order; incompatible universes
fail before plotting. MDS axes remain lane-specific. Samples are never
intersected, padded, or relabelled to make incompatible inputs appear comparable.

Kidney additionally writes `Kidney_KPMP_full_mds_region.pdf`, coloured by
`region.l1` (Cortex, Medulla, Papilla). This is an anatomical diagnostic, not
an additional correction covariate; `datasets.json` is unchanged. Region labels
must agree between both lanes. Unrecorded regions remain visible as NA points
and are excluded from region-specific scores, without dropping samples or
changing their MDS coordinates.

Each side displays its own label-specific ANOSIM and **Separation score**:
the arithmetic mean of ANOSIM, ARI (the existing Ward/PAM average), and adjusted
SNN modularity with `k = 3`. These are raw scores, not heatmap-normalized scores.
ANOSIM statistics for the batch panels require no permutations. Missing labels
remain visible as NA points but are excluded from scoring; non-estimable scores
are shown as NA. Biological panels reuse persisted R scores when available.

# Corrected funkyheatmap

As in the uncorrected notebook, min–max normalize each metric within each cohort,
then average the normalized values for the overall, dataset, and metric columns.
Higher is better for ANOSIM, adjusted kNN-3 modularity, and ARI. Runtime is excluded.

```{r funkyheatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
clean_data <- funky_metric_data %>%
  mutate(score = factor(score, levels = names(metric_keys))) %>%
  group_by(dataset, score) %>%
  mutate(value = min_max(value)) %>%
  ungroup()

df_overall <- clean_data %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  summarise(Overall_Score = mean(value), .groups = "drop")
df_datasets <- clean_data %>%
  group_by(method, dataset) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = method, names_from = dataset, values_from = value, names_prefix = "Dataset__")
df_metrics <- clean_data %>%
  group_by(method, score) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = method, names_from = score, values_from = value, names_prefix = "Metric__")
final_data <- df_overall %>%
  left_join(df_datasets, by = "method") %>%
  left_join(df_metrics, by = "method") %>%
  mutate(id = method) %>%
  arrange(desc(Overall_Score))

dataset_labels <- dataset_summary %>%
  arrange(dataset) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(dataset, " (n cell types = ", n_cell_types, ")"))

column_info <- bind_rows(
  tibble(id = "id", group = "", name = "", geom = "text", palette = NA_character_, options = list(list(hjust = 0, width = 6))),
  tibble(id = "Overall_Score", group = "Overall", name = "Mean", geom = "bar", palette = "palette_overall", options = list(list(width = 4))),
  tibble(id = paste0("Dataset__", dataset_labels$dataset), group = "Datasets", name = dataset_labels$label, geom = "circle", palette = "Datasets", options = rep(list(list()), length(batch_datasets))),
  tibble(id = paste0("Metric__", names(metric_keys)), group = "Metrics", name = names(metric_keys), geom = "bar", palette = "Metrics", options = rep(list(list(width = 2)), length(metric_keys)))
)
ncolors <- 11L
heatmap <- funky_heatmap(
  data = final_data,
  column_info = column_info,
  scale_column = FALSE,
  palettes = list(
    palette_overall = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(ncolors, "RdBu"),
    Datasets = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(ncolors, "RdBu"),
    Metrics = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(ncolors, "RdBu")
  ),
  column_groups = tibble(group = c("Overall", "Datasets", "Metrics")),
  legends = list(
    list(palette = "palette_overall", enabled = TRUE, title = "Mean normalized score", labels = c(". Min", rep("", ncolors - 2L), "Max .")),
    list(palette = "Datasets", enabled = TRUE, title = "Dataset score", labels = c(". Min", rep("", ncolors - 2L), "Max .")),
    list(palette = "Metrics", enabled = TRUE, title = "Metric score", labels = c(". Min", rep("", ncolors - 2L), "Max ."))
  ),
  position_args = position_arguments(col_width = 1.5, col_space = 0.2, col_annot_offset = 5)
)
dir.create(plot_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave(plot_path, heatmap, width = 12, height = 7, units = "in", device = "pdf")
stopifnot(file.exists(plot_path), file.info(plot_path)$size > 0)
heatmap
```

# Outputs

- `plots/batch_effect_corrected/batch_effect_corrected_funkyheatmap.pdf`
- `plots/batch_effect_corrected/<dataset>_mds.pdf` (biological labels)
- `plots/batch_effect_corrected/<dataset>_mds_batch_<column>.pdf` for each batch column
- `plots/batch_effect_corrected/<dataset>_mds_batch_combined.pdf` for multiple batch columns;
  legend values follow the subtitle's column order and are separated by ` | `
- `plots/batch_effect_corrected/Kidney_KPMP_full_mds_region.pdf` (anatomical `region.l1`)
- `data/batch_effect/corrected/20261105_corrected_heatmap/heatmap_scores.csv`
  and its checksum sidecar: the only local data needed for offline heatmap plotting.
- Shared bio/batch matrices and composition CSVs: `data/batch_effect/bio_vs_batch/tables/`
- Shared annotated bio/batch heatmaps: `plots/batch_effect_bio_vs_batch/`
- Kidney region matrix: `plots/batch_effect_bio_vs_batch/Kidney_KPMP_full_bio_vs_batch_region.l1.pdf`,
  with matching `_counts.csv` and `_composition.csv` files in the shared table directory.

All MDS PDFs in this directory are uncorrected-versus-corrected comparisons;
the uncorrected notebook's standalone panels remain in its separate plot root.

The snapshot contains 216 metric rows (nine cohorts × eight displayed methods,
including `Shuffled_baseline`, × three metrics). It is a derived plotting artifact,
not a replacement for the authoritative corrected-final results.
